newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai conglomerates aim to join world top 500.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai conglomerates aim to join world top 500.

text.p: China's biggest city has come up with a list of 54 industrial conglomerates it aims to nurture into the ranks of the world's 500 biggest companies within the next few years, the Business News said on Wednesday.

"To support big industrial groups is an important strategic task for Shanghai's long-term economic development," executive deputy mayor Chen Liangyu told a meeting of city fathers on Tuesday, when the list was announced, the newspaper said.
"Our aim is to push a few big industrial groups into the ranks of the 100 biggest companies nationwide and 500 largest firms in the world after a few years of hard work," Chen said.
No details were given of how the 54 firms would be propelled onto the world stage.

The list included Shanghai Electric Industrial Group, the city's premier auto maker Shanghai Automobile Group and the city's largest foreign trade firm, Orient International (Holdings) Co, the newspaper said.
Also listed were a number of Shanghai-listed B share firms including Shanghai New Asia (Group) Co, Shanghai Refrigerator Compressor Co and Shanghai Hero Co, it said.

The list also included parent companies for listed Shanghai Friendship and Overseas Chinese Co, Shanghai Lujiazui Finance and Trade Zone Development Co, Shanghai Jinjiang Tower Co, Shanghai Shangling Electric Appliances Co, China First Pencil Co and Shanghai Kaikai Industrial Co.
